# QATQ v0.4.3: Dependency maintenance

QATQ v0.4.3 refreshes compression and research dependencies while retaining the existing exact tensor compression interfaces and file formats.

## What changed

- **Compression:** Zstd moves to 0.14.2 with updated safe and native bindings.
- **Research tooling:** num-bigint 0.5.1, SHA-2 0.11.1, and serde_json 1.0.154 refresh the arithmetic, digest, and JSON dependencies.
- **Release delivery:** Updated artifact upload and download actions improve retry handling for rate-limited requests.

## Compatibility

QATQ and QATC wire formats, public APIs, Capacity Oracle certificate semantics, and the research-only geometry profiler retain their existing contracts. This maintenance release makes no new compression-performance or capacity claims.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/kabudu/qatq/blob/v0.4.3/CHANGELOG.md) and [release validation evidence](https://github.com/kabudu/qatq/blob/v0.4.3/docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_0_4_3_EVIDENCE.md).

## Install

Install the release binaries with:

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/kabudu/qatq/releases/download/v0.4.3/qatq-installer.sh | sh
```
